# opalstack_dnsrecord (Data Source)

Looks up a DNS record by `id`. A record has no name to look it up by.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A record has no name, so it is looked up by its UUID.
data "opalstack_dnsrecord" "mx" {
  id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
}

output "mx_target" {
  value = data.opalstack_dnsrecord.mx.content
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the record.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Value of the record.
- `domain_id` (String) UUID of the domain the record belongs to.
- `priority` (Number) Priority, for the types that use one.
- `ttl` (Number) Time to live in seconds.
- `type` (String) Record type, such as `A`, `MX` or `TXT`.
